task_instance: Created a small sample iOS app project (sample_app/: Info.plist, MoodJournal.entitlements, LoginView.swift, PurchaseManager.swift + inline PaywallView, ContentView.swift + inline AnalyticsTracker) with realistic, deliberate App Store rejection risks (vague permission usage strings, login wall with Facebook/Google but no Sign in with Apple despite the entitlement being declared, external purchase link alongside IAP, no restore-purchases flow, IDFA/analytics collection with no ATT prompt and no privacy manifest). Then performed the skill's full App Store review: identified the app's core purpose and flows, flagged top rejection risks, ran the compliance checklist, verified current guideline wording (5.1.1, 3.1.1, 3.1.2(c), 4.8) via a live fetch of developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/, and produced the full required report structure (Executive Summary, prioritized Risk Register table, Detailed Findings by category, Reviewer Experience Checklist, draft App Review Notes, and a Next-Pass offer) in app_store_review_output.md, without editing any of the sample app's code.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_gr/github__awesome-copilot__apple-appstore-reviewer@office-assistant/. Sample app files created: sample_app/Info.plist (vague NSCameraUsageDescription/NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription, no NSUserTrackingUsageDescription), sample_app/MoodJournal.entitlements (declares com.apple.developer.applesignin, unused in code), sample_app/LoginView.swift (Facebook/Google login, no Apple sign-in, no guest mode), sample_app/PurchaseManager.swift (StoreKit 2 purchase + inline PaywallView with an external purchase link, no restore function/button, no price-period disclosure), sample_app/ContentView.swift (camera/photo/location usage + inline AnalyticsTracker reading ASIdentifierManager.advertisingIdentifier and identifierForVendor with no consent gate). Used WebFetch on https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/ to confirm current section numbers/wording for 5.1.1, 3.1.1, 3.1.2(c), and 4.8 before citing them. Wrote the full review deliverable to app_store_review_output.md, containing all six required sections (Executive Summary; Risk Register table with Priority/Area/Finding/Why/Evidence/Recommendation/Effort/Confidence columns for 10 findings; Detailed Findings grouped by the 7 required categories, each with What/Why/Change/Verify; Reviewer Experience Checklist; draft Suggested Reviewer Notes; Next-Pass offer) plus a section listing the live-verified guideline references. Verified the deliverable by re-reading the file's content as written (Write tool echoes full content) and confirming every required output section from SKILL.md's 'Output Requirements' is present, every risk-register row cites concrete file/symbol evidence from the sample files actually created, no code in sample_app/ was modified after creation, and unverifiable items (e.g. account deletion, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy presence outside scope) are explicitly labeled 'Unverified' per the skill's evidence standard. No shell/code execution, no binary files, and no MCP/connector tools were used at any point.
